title: Escape from Earth
description: Help Eliter the little dinosaur outrun a homing missile, jump over walls and grab coins across four pixel-art stages in this free browser game.
about:
Escape from Earth is a pixel-art auto-runner with a story. Eliter, a small dinosaur, comes back to Earth hoping to find it green and peaceful, but discovers factories and armies instead, and soon a missile is on his tail. He runs on his own: your only job is to time his jumps.

Each stage is a hand-built level full of floating platforms, tall walls and coins arranged in arcs that hint at the perfect jump. Get stuck against a wall and the missile catches up and explodes; fall off the level and the run is over too. Reach the end of a stage to blow up the missile and earn a bonus, then move on to the next one. After the fourth stage the loop starts again at a higher speed.

Your five best runs are saved as a high score table, so there is always a reason to try one more time.
howToPlay: Eliter runs to the right automatically while a missile chases him. Press the Up arrow, click or tap to jump, and hold it for a higher jump. Use the platforms to climb over walls and collect coins for points. Reach the end of the stage to destroy the missile and earn a bonus; getting hit by the missile or falling ends the game.

controls.action: Skip the intro and start or retry

tips: Follow the coin arcs: they show where a jump should start and land.
Tall walls cannot be cleared from the ground, so jump onto the nearest platform first and leap from there.
Release the jump early for short hops, which keeps you low and fast between platforms.
Do not stall against a wall: every moment you lose lets the missile get closer.

faq.question: Is Escape from Earth free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. Escape from Earth is completely free and runs in your browser with no download or sign-up.

faq.question: Can I play Escape from Earth on a phone or tablet?
faq.answer: Yes. Tap and hold anywhere on the screen to jump. The game is wide, so it is best played with the device turned sideways.

faq.question: Are my high scores saved?
faq.answer: Yes. Your five best runs, with their points and speed, are saved in your browser on this device and shown on the game over screen.
